Only download documents matching specified MIME types (PDF only, not DOCX)

```elixir title="Elixir"
engine_config = "{\"document_mime_types\":[\"application/pdf\"],\"download_documents\":true,\"respect_robots_txt\":false}"
{:ok, engine} = Crawlberg.create_engine(engine_config)
url = "https://example.com"
result = Crawlberg.scrape_async(engine, url)
IO.inspect(result.downloaded_document.mime_type)
```
